newsitem.title: USA: MFS computes dividend on depositary shares.
newsitem.headline: MFS computes dividend on depositary shares.

text.p: MFS Communications Co Inc said on Friday that it will pay the quarterly dividend on its Series A eight percent cumulative convertible preferred stock (DECS) in shares of common stock based on a formula established under terms of the DECS.
Each depositary share will receive 0.0147123 of a share of MFS' common stock. A total of 139,755 shares of common stock will be issued by the company in connection with this dividend.

As previously annunced, MFS will pay the quarterly dividend on November 29, 1996 of $0.67 on each of its depositary shares, each representing a one-hundredth interest in a share of MFS' Series A DECS.
